description.value: Black Diamond Bar & Grill is a full-service mountain restaurant and bar at Big White ski resort, owned by Don and Theresa Hickson, built around a farm-to-table philosophy using locally sourced seasonal ingredients. The kitchen produces scratch-made dishes ranging from French Onion Soup to Blackened Mahi Mahi, while the bar pours handcrafted cocktails alongside a broad beer and cider selection. Cyclists who make the climb up Big White Road will find a warm alpine refuge with lunch, all-day, and dinner menus in a cozy, fire-warmed setting.
